name: PAX2 Classifier

candidate.method: L2 logistic regression (lambda 2.0 on standardized features, intercept free) on 18544 settled shorts from 64 channels, 14438 with a transcript; validated leave-one-channel-out and on a time split at 2026-07-01.
candidate.target: breakout: lifetime views at least 3x the channel's median of settled shorts

features.label: Title of six words or fewer
Title of fifteen words or more
Call to action in the description
Title said in the first ten seconds

encoderHeldOut.note: topDecileRate and topDecileLift added on the Mac from predictions-v3.jsonl (held-out rows, the full arm); indexRun is the serving index whose embeddings.npy the run read

transcriptFeatures.rule: src/lib/transcript-features.ts; vocabulary: unigrams and bigrams in at least 20 transcripts and at most 50% of them, the 400 most frequent; idf ln((1+N)/(1+df))+1; a transcript counts at 10 words or more

embedding.rule: pre-registered 2026-10-20 in train_v3.py: the candidate is whichever of embed and full scores higher on the encoder-held-out channels' rows; it passes when, on those rows, its AUC is above v1's 0.604 and above the metadata model's, and its within-channel AUC is at least 0.55. Pooled AUC includes channels the encoder trained on and never gates.

caveats: Observational: a coefficient is association within and across channels, not the effect of the input.
The encoder was fine-tuned with the breakout label on every channel but its held-out ones; only those channels' rows judge the embedding.
Encoder components are directions in the embedding, not named traits.
